relations: The tethered white block tilts forward, pulling its string taut against the underside of the ramp.
The block continues to lean until it settles flat on the floor at the base of the domino curve.
The ball, ramp, and background dominoes remain fixed while the white block topples.
The camera maintains a static high-angle view of the colorful layout throughout the sequence.
caption: The video showcases an elaborate domino and marble-run arrangement laid out on a wooden floor, with a light-wood ramp resting on two orange cube supports in the foreground and a pale ball perched on its raised left end. A tall white rectangular block stands upright in front of the left support, tethered by a thin string to the underside of the ramp. In the background, additional upright and toppled domino patterns sit beside wooden tower structures. Throughout the clip the ball, the ramp, the standing white domino curve, and the collapsed piles of purple, teal, and white pieces remain fixed. The only motion is the gradual toppling of the tethered white block, which tilts forward, its string pulling taut as it tips. The block continues to lean until it settles flat on the floor at the base of the domino curve. The camera holds the same high-angle view of the colorful layout throughout.
